subject: Supplier activation readiness — roadmap & PO owner requests
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmelogistics.com>, procurement@acmelogistics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation readiness — roadmap & PO owner requests

Hi Elena / Acme team,

Thanks for moving this forward. To keep momentum on the activation we put together a short readiness roadmap and a minimal document checklist — please see the asks below. If you can return the items marked "Required (fast)" by EOD Friday (5/28), we can get the account live and route the first PO by the following week.

What we need from Acme (what will unblock activation)
- Completed vendor W-9 or equivalent tax form — Required (fast) — attach as PDF (ACME_W9.pdf)
- Banking details form (for ACH) — Required (fast) — see attached banking-details-form.pdf; if you prefer wire please indicate and include beneficiary info
- Primary PO owner & AP contact (name, role, email, phone) — Required (fast)
- Invoice routing preference (email, EDI, vendor portal) and default remittance email
- Any PO-level billing code/GL mapping you require (if not, we’ll use our default)
- Insurance certificate (if your policy requires) — Optional for first PO

What Redwood will provide / next steps
- Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx attached — please confirm PO acceptance terms (net30 default)
- Vendor-Checklist.pdf attached with timeline and technical touchpoints (API/portal access, EDI setup if applicable)
- Once the required docs are received we'll: create vendor in our AP system, provision PO owner access in the vendor portal, and issue a test PO for $1 to validate remittance (or issue nominal invoice depending on your preference)

Questions: Do you have a dedicated EDI integration team or should we route EDI details through your AP contact? Also please confirm your preferred legal entity name for tax and invoicing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Vendor-Checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Elena Torres <elena@acmelogistics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmelogistics.com, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmelogistics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation readiness — roadmap & PO owner requests

Hi Mateo — thanks for the clear list. We can get most items over this week. Quick responses below: 

- W-9: attached (ACME_W9.pdf)
- Banking: we prefer ACH; I’m attaching the completed banking-details-form.pdf.
- PO owner / AP contact: Elena Torres (Head of Procurement) — elena@acmelogistics.com; AP contact is Carlos Mendes — c.mendes@acmelogistics.com (cc’d)
- Invoice routing: send invoices to ap@acmelogistics.com; we also support EDI but the onboarding is handled by a separate team (cc’ing Carlos)
- Billing codes: we’ll accept Redwood’s default for the first two POs and follow up if needed

We have a brief internal insurance review but it won’t block the initial PO. I’ll coordinate with Carlos on EDI paperwork if we go that route.

Attaching: ACME_W9.pdf, banking-details-form.pdf

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Procurement, Acme Logistics
elena@acmelogistics.com
+1 (312) 555-0144

Attachments: ACME_W9.pdf (PDF), banking-details-form.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmelogistics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation readiness — roadmap & PO owner requests

Hi Elena — great, thanks for sending those quickly. A couple of operational clarifications from AP/ops: 

1) PO terms: Redwood default is Net30 unless a negotiated SLA exists. If Acme requires different terms for the first PO (e.g., Net45), please confirm and we’ll surface to finance.
2) AP contact verification: Carlos, can you confirm the AP mailbox (ap@acmelogistics.com) accepts PDF invoices and whether you require a specific subject line or PO reference format? We validate incoming invoices to match PO# in the subject line.
3) Remittance testing: we will issue a test PO (no goods) for $1 next Wednesday (6/2) to validate remittance details — please confirm you are OK with that approach or provide an alternate test flow.
4) EDI: If you want to pursue EDI, we need the endpoint URL and contact for the EDI team. Otherwise we’ll proceed via the portal/email for initial runs.

Operational attachments: I’ve updated the PO template with our preferred invoice footer and sample PO# pattern — see attached: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (updated).

If everything above looks fine I’ll create your vendor record on Friday and schedule the test PO for next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment references: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (PO numbering sample)

From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmelogistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation readiness — roadmap & PO owner requests

Marissa / Mateo / Elena — confirming the following from Acme AP: 

- ap@acmelogistics.com accepts PDF invoices. Please include "PO# <number>" in the subject line and include the PO number on page 1 of the invoice.
- Net30 is fine for the first two POs.
- The ACH details provided match our records; we approve the $1 test PO next Wednesday (6/2) to verify routing.
- EDI: we will not enable EDI for the first month; coordinate via email for now. If you need to open an EDI ticket later, contact me and I’ll loop in our integration lead.

Thanks — Carlos
Carlos Mendes
Accounts Payable Manager, Acme Logistics
c.mendes@acmelogistics.com
+1 (312) 555-0122
